source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of functional and non-functional requirements with Table 1.1 (PDF 7-8).

blocks.text: Requirements aam taur par do qismon mein baanti jati hain: functional aur non-functional requirements.

Functional requirements system ke khaas kaam (functions) aur behavior (system kaise chalta hai) batati hain. Yeh batati hain ke system ko kya karna chahiye: kaun se tasks, services aur features system ko lazmi karne hain. Yeh system aur us ke users, ya doosre systems, ke darmiyan len den (interactions) ko tay karti hain.
Library Management System ki functional requirements.

items: User Registration: system users (students, faculty) ko register karne aur account banane de.
Book Borrowing: system users ko kitabein dhoondne aur udhaar (borrow) lene de.
Book Return: system users ko udhaar li hui kitabein wapas karne de.
Inventory Management: librarians inventory (kitabon ke stock) mein kitabein add, update aur remove kar sakein.
Notification: system users ko wapsi ki tareekh (due date) aur der se wapas hone wali (overdue) kitabon ki notification (khabar) bheje.

blocks.text: Non-functional requirements system ki quality attributes (quality ki khoobiyan), performance criteria (napne ke paimane) aur constraints (pabandiyan / hadein) tay karti hain. Yeh batati hain ke system koi kaam kaise (kitni achi tarah) karta hai, yeh nahi ke kya karta hai. In mein usability (istemal mein aasani), reliability (bharosa), performance aur security jaisi cheezein aati hain.
Library Management System ki non-functional requirements.

items: Performance: system ek hi waqt mein 1000 tak users ko sust (slow) hue baghair sambhale.
Usability: user interface aasani se samajh aaye aur chalane mein aasan ho, ta ke users kam mehnat se kaam kar sakein.
Reliability: system 99.9% waqt chalta (available) rahe, yani bohat kam waqt band (downtime) ho.
Security: user ka data encrypted (khufiya code mein) ho, aur access mehfooz authentication (pehchan ki jaanch) se control ho.
Scalability: system barhte hue users aur inventory ki barhti kitabon ko sambhalne ke liye barh sake.

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Aasan pehchan: agar requirement ek kaam batati hai ("user kitab borrow kar sake") to functional hai. Agar yeh batati hai ke kaam kitna tez, mehfooz ya bharosay wala ho ("1000 users ek saath", "99.9% waqt chalta rahe") to non-functional hai.

blocks.prompt: Kaun si requirement batati hai ke system ko kaise perform karna chahiye? (Exercise MCQ 2) Functional aur non-functional requirements mein farq likhein. (Short Question 1)
blocks.explanation: Non-Functional Requirements, option (b). Functional requirements batati hain ke system kya kare (registration, borrow, return, inventory, notification). Non-functional requirements batati hain ke system kitni achi tarah kare (1000 users ek saath, 99.9% availability, encryption, aasan interface, scalability).

items: Functional: system kya karta hai (library: registration, borrowing, return, inventory, notification).
Non-functional: system kaise karta hai (performance, usability, reliability, security, scalability); Table 1.1 farq dikhati hai.
